lead: Two to twenty reviews, each with its rating, text and author. The rating also appears as a number, because screen readers can't read star graphics.
note: Use the note to say who collected the reviews and whether you can edit them.

reviews.quote_text: The stars come from the rating field, and the same number is printed beside them.
